name: 葉宗軒
objective:
本課程探討人類的感官體驗、日常質感與生活美學，如何隨歷史上的關鍵技術轉折點而被集體形塑與重構。

課程將從「前工業時代」的自然感知與生活思辨出發；跨越「工業技術革命時代」對都市空間、日常生活與大眾消費符號的重塑；延伸至「大眾影音媒介時代」，剖析流行文化與聲音質地如何紀錄並定義集體的時代記憶與次文化認同；一路推進至「當代數位浪潮與 AI 世代」，探討演算法視覺、虛擬空間與當代數位語言對人類感官邊界與生活體驗的全新詮釋。

學習過程結合參與式創新教學與數位科技融入等跨領域方法，期許學生透過創新方式進行創作與發表。

This course explores how human sensory experiences, everyday textures, and aesthetics have been collectively shaped and reconstructed alongside pivotal technological turning points throughout history.

The curriculum begins with natural perception and reflections on daily life in the "Pre-Industrial Era"; spans the "Age of Industrial and Technological Revolutions," examining the reshaping of urban spaces, daily routines, and mass consumer symbols; extends into the "Mass Audio-Visual Media Era," analyzing how pop culture and acoustic textures record and define collective memories and subcultural identities; and pushes forward into the "Contemporary Digital Wave and AI Era," investigating the novel interpretations of human sensory boundaries and life experiences brought by algorithmic visuals, virtual spaces, and contemporary digital languages.

Integrating interdisciplinary approaches such as participatory innovative teaching and digital technology integration, the learning process encourages students to engage in creative production and presentation through innovative formats.
課程進度(1-16週):
W1. 洞穴生活：感官源起 Cave Life: Sensory Origins

W2. 感知與美學起點 The Dawn of Perception and Aesthetics

W3. 光的設計革命：從火光到人工照明 The Light Design Revolution: From Firelight to Artificial Lighting 

W4. 文化科技專題：光的設計與視覺革命 Cultural Tech Topic: Light Design and Visual Revolutions

W5. 文化發展專題：工業革命、品牌與住居演進 Cultural Development Topic: The Industrial Revolution, Branding, and Modern Living

W6. 文化生活專題：飲食文化的歷史演進 Cultural Life Topic: The Historical Evolution of Food Culture

W7. 餐桌上的記憶：食材風土與家族味覺 Memories on the Table: Terroir and Family Culinary Memory

W8. 期中企劃發表：歷史感知與記憶採集 Midterm Proposal Presentation: Historical Perception and Memory Gathering

W9. 大眾媒介與視覺符號的興起 The Rise of Mass Media and Visual Symbols

W10. 影像美學轉變：從底片膠卷到數位世代 Transformations in Cinematic Aesthetics: From Film Rolls to the Digital Era

W11. 聲音的歷史演進與時代音色 Historical Evolution of Sound and Timbre of the Eras

W12. 臺灣現代生活美學的歷史轉譯 Historical Translation of Modern Taiwanese Living Aesthetics

W13. 臺灣影音記憶與時代穿搭演變：偶像、明星與穿搭 Taiwanese Audio-Visual Memory and Fashion Evolution: Icons, Celebrities, and Style

W14. 虛擬空間與當代感知 Virtual Spaces and Contemporary Perception

W15. 期末專案工作坊 Final Project Workshop 進行期末創作

W16. 期末展演與創作發表 Final Exhibition and Creative Showcase
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          W17. 彈性學習：感官移地採集與數位創作實踐 
Flexible Learning: Off-Site Sensory Gathering and Digital Creative Practice 

W18. 彈性學習：成果擴散與線上策展發表 
Flexible Learning: Showcase Diffusion and Online Exhibition Presentation
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          學生能自學習與實作，並透過線上平臺完成數位作品發表，展現將日常體驗轉譯為當代文化企劃的實踐能力。

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
